The Tenant shall pay eleven months' rent in advance at the start of the agreement, which shall be non-refundable in any circumstances.
Electricity charges shall be payable at a rate of Rs. 15 per unit as determined by the Landlord's sub-meter, irrespective of the tariff charged by the electricity board.
The monthly rent of Rs. 18,000 shall remain fixed for the entire term of this agreement and shall not be increased for any reason.
The Landlord shall issue a signed rent receipt for every payment and shall accept payment by bank transfer to the account specified in Schedule A.
If any part of the premises becomes unusable due to defects not caused by the Tenant, the rent shall be reduced proportionately until the defect is rectified.
Society maintenance charges, property tax and all statutory levies on the premises shall be borne solely by the Landlord.
The security deposit of Rs. 2,00,000 shall be refunded only after the Landlord finds a new tenant for the premises.
The Landlord may deduct from the security deposit any amount he deems fit towards repairs, painting, cleaning or other expenses, and his decision shall be final.
One month's rent shall be deducted from the security deposit at the time of vacating towards painting charges, irrespective of the condition of the premises.
The security deposit shall stand forfeited in full if the Tenant vacates the premises before the expiry of the agreement for any reason.
The Tenant shall pay a deposit equal to ten months' rent, which shall be refunded without interest within ninety days of handing over possession.
The security deposit shall be refunded in full within seven days of the Tenant handing over vacant possession, failing which the Landlord shall pay interest at 18% per annum on the amount due.
Any deductions from the security deposit shall be limited to actual, documented damage beyond normal wear and tear, supported by itemised bills shared with the Tenant.
The Tenant shall be entitled to adjust the security deposit against the last two months' rent of the tenancy.
A joint inspection of the premises shall be carried out at the start and end of the tenancy, and no deduction shall be made for any condition recorded at move-in.
The Landlord may terminate this agreement and require the Tenant to vacate the premises at any time without assigning any reason by giving seven days' notice.
There shall be a lock-in period of the entire term of eleven months, during which the Tenant shall not terminate the agreement, but the Landlord may terminate it by giving one month's notice.
If the Tenant fails to pay rent for any month, the Landlord shall be entitled to disconnect water and electricity and re-enter the premises without further notice.
Upon termination, any belongings of the Tenant left in the premises shall become the property of the Landlord and may be disposed of as he deems fit.
If the Tenant terminates the agreement before the expiry of the term, the Tenant shall pay rent for the remaining unexpired period of the agreement.
The Tenant may terminate this agreement at any time by giving one month's written notice, while the Landlord may terminate only for breach of this agreement after giving three months' written notice.
The Landlord shall not terminate this agreement during the first eleven months except in case of non-payment of rent for two consecutive months.
If the Tenant is transferred out of the city by his employer, he may terminate this agreement with fifteen days' notice without any penalty or forfeiture of deposit.
The Tenant shall not be evicted from the premises except through due process of law, and the Landlord shall not disconnect any essential services under any circumstances.
On every renewal, the rent shall be increased by 15% over the last paid rent, and the Tenant shall pay a fresh brokerage and agreement charge.
Renewal of this agreement shall be at the sole discretion of the Landlord on such terms as he may decide at that time.
This agreement shall automatically renew for further periods of eleven months unless the Tenant gives three months' notice before expiry, and the lock-in shall apply afresh to every renewal.
The Tenant shall bear the entire stamp duty, registration charges and legal fees for the agreement and every renewal thereof.
If the agreement is not renewed, the Landlord may increase the rent for any holding-over period to such amount as he determines.
The Tenant shall have the option to renew this agreement for two further terms of eleven months each, and the Landlord shall not refuse such renewal except for breach by the Tenant.
Any increase in rent on renewal shall not exceed 5% of the rent last paid.
Stamp duty and registration charges for this agreement and any renewal shall be shared equally between the Landlord and the Tenant.
The Landlord shall inform the Tenant in writing at least two months before expiry whether he intends to renew, failing which the agreement shall be deemed renewed on the same terms.
All repairs to the premises, whether minor or major, including structural repairs, plumbing, roof leakage and electrical wiring, shall be carried out by the Tenant at his own cost.
The Tenant shall get the entire premises repainted at his own cost before vacating, irrespective of the duration of the tenancy.
The Tenant shall hand back the premises in the same condition as at the start of the tenancy, and any deterioration whatsoever shall be made good by the Tenant.
Any fixtures, fittings or improvements installed by the Tenant shall become the property of the Landlord on vacating, without any compensation.
The Landlord shall not be responsible for repair of any appliance supplied with the premises, and the Tenant shall replace any appliance that stops working.
The Landlord shall carry out all structural repairs and repairs to plumbing, wiring and supplied appliances within seven days of written intimation by the Tenant.
If the Landlord fails to carry out necessary repairs within fifteen days of notice, the Tenant may get them done and deduct the reasonable cost from the rent.
The Tenant shall be responsible only for minor day-to-day repairs costing up to Rs. 500 per instance; all other repairs shall be borne by the Landlord.
The Tenant may remove any fixtures and fittings installed at his own cost at the end of the tenancy, provided any damage caused by removal is made good.
If rent is not paid by the 5th of the month, the Tenant shall pay a late fee of Rs. 500 per day until payment is made.
Any delay in payment of rent shall attract interest at 36% per annum, compounded monthly.
If the Tenant fails to vacate on expiry, he shall pay damages at three times the monthly rent for every day of overstay.
The Landlord may impose such fines as he deems fit for any breach of the house rules by the Tenant or his guests.
A penalty of one month's rent shall be payable if the Tenant fails to give notice in the prescribed form, even if notice has otherwise been given.
Late payment charges, if any, shall not exceed 2% of the monthly rent and shall apply only after a grace period of ten days.
No penalty shall be levied for delay in payment of rent caused by bank holidays or technical failure of the payment system.
If the Landlord delays refund of the security deposit beyond fifteen days, he shall pay the Tenant Rs. 500 for each day of delay.
Overstay charges, if any, shall be limited to the pro-rated monthly rent for the actual number of days the Tenant remains in occupation.
The Landlord or his agents may enter the premises at any time, with or without notice, for inspection or any other purpose.
The Landlord shall retain a duplicate key to the premises and may use it to enter in the absence of the Tenant.
During the last two months of the tenancy, the Tenant shall permit prospective tenants and buyers to view the premises at any time convenient to the Landlord.
The Tenant shall not change the locks or install any additional lock on the premises without the Landlord's permission.
The Landlord may install CCTV cameras in the common areas and inside the premises for security purposes.
The Landlord may enter the premises only after giving at least 24 hours' prior written notice and between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m., except in case of emergency.
The Landlord shall not retain any key to the premises during the tenancy, and all keys shall be handed over to the Tenant.
The Tenant may change the locks at his own cost, provided the original locks are reinstated on vacating.
Inspections by the Landlord shall not exceed once every three months and shall be conducted in the presence of the Tenant.
The Tenant shall indemnify the Landlord against all losses, claims, damages and legal costs of whatever nature arising in connection with the premises.
The Landlord shall not be liable for any loss, injury or damage to the Tenant, his family or belongings, howsoever caused, including due to defects in the building.
The Tenant shall bear all legal costs incurred by the Landlord in any dispute arising out of this agreement, regardless of the outcome.
The Tenant shall be responsible for any damage to neighbouring flats or common areas arising from leakage from the premises, whatever the cause.
The Tenant shall be liable for any dues of previous occupants for electricity, water or maintenance charges outstanding on the premises.
The Landlord shall be responsible for any loss or injury caused to the Tenant or his family due to structural defects or failure of the Landlord to carry out repairs.
The Tenant's liability under this agreement shall be limited to damage caused by his own negligence or wilful act, and shall in no case exceed the amount of the security deposit.
The Landlord shall indemnify the Tenant against any claim by a third party, bank or financier asserting rights over the premises.
The Landlord confirms that all dues for electricity, water, society maintenance and taxes up to the date of commencement have been paid, and he shall bear any such arrears.
The Tenant shall not have any guests staying overnight in the premises without the prior written consent of the Landlord.
The Tenant shall not keep any pets, cook non-vegetarian food, or hold any functions in the premises.
The Tenant shall comply with such rules and regulations as the Landlord may frame from time to time, and any breach shall be a ground for immediate termination.
The Tenant shall not use the parking area, terrace or any common facility of the building.
Only the Tenant named herein may reside in the premises, and no family member shall reside without the Landlord's prior written approval.
The Tenant shall be entitled to the exclusive use of one covered parking space and shared use of the terrace and other common amenities at no extra cost.
The Tenant may keep domestic pets in the premises, provided they do not cause nuisance to neighbours.
The Tenant may use one room of the premises as a home office for professional work, provided it does not cause disturbance to other residents.
The Tenant's family members and guests may reside in or visit the premises without any requirement of consent from the Landlord.
